_about: Judge prompts for Part I, fixed before the main experiment grid was run (git history records when). The state given to a judge is {task, reference, segment summary}; it never contains the environment's reward. Kev-4B receives the state and the questions through the System One schema (kev.api); the autoregressive judge receives the same text in a chat prompt (dcjev/judges/ar_judge.py).

Hopper-v5.task: A one-legged hopping robot (MuJoCo Hopper) must hop forward along the x-axis as fast as possible without falling over.
Hopper-v5.reference: When the robot stands upright its torso is about 1.25 m above the ground. A strong policy for this robot hops forward at about 3 m/s.
progress: failing: it falls over, or it moves backward
poor: it stays up but makes little or no forward progress
fair: it moves forward, but slowly
good: it moves forward at a solid speed
excellent: it moves forward fast while staying upright and in control
Hopper-v5.healthy: Is the robot making genuine forward progress with a controlled, upright gait (not fallen, not falling, not standing still)?

Walker2d-v5.task: A two-legged walking robot (MuJoCo Walker2d) must walk or run forward along the x-axis as fast as possible without falling over.
Walker2d-v5.reference: When the robot stands upright its torso is about 1.25 m above the ground. A strong policy for this robot runs forward at about 4 m/s.
progress: failing: it falls over, or it moves backward
poor: it stays up but makes little or no forward progress
fair: it moves forward, but slowly
good: it moves forward at a solid speed
excellent: it moves forward fast while staying upright and in control
Walker2d-v5.healthy: Is the robot making genuine forward progress with a controlled, upright gait (not fallen, not falling, not standing still)?

HalfCheetah-v5.task: A planar cheetah-like robot with two legs (MuJoCo HalfCheetah) must run forward along the x-axis as fast as possible.
HalfCheetah-v5.reference: The robot cannot fall, but it can flip onto its back, which is undesirable. A strong policy for this robot runs forward at about 10 m/s.
progress: failing: it moves backward, or it has flipped onto its back
poor: it makes little or no forward progress
fair: it moves forward, but slowly
good: it runs forward at a solid speed
excellent: it runs forward fast with a controlled, upright posture
HalfCheetah-v5.healthy: Is the robot running forward with an upright, coordinated gait (not flipped onto its back, not stuck in place)?

Swimmer-v5.task: A three-segment swimming robot in a viscous fluid (MuJoCo Swimmer) must swim forward along the x-axis as fast as possible.
Swimmer-v5.reference: Motion in the fluid is slow: a strong policy for this robot swims forward at about 0.3 m/s.
progress: failing: it moves backward
poor: it makes little or no forward progress
fair: it moves forward, but slowly
good: it swims forward at a solid speed
excellent: it swims forward fast
Swimmer-v5.healthy: Is the robot swimming forward with a coordinated undulating motion (not drifting backward, not stuck)?

Reacher-v5.task: A two-joint robot arm (MuJoCo Reacher) must move its fingertip to a target point and keep it there, using as little control effort as possible.
Reacher-v5.reference: The arm is about 0.21 m long. A fingertip within about 0.01 m of the target is on target; control effort ranges from 0 (none) to 1 (maximum).
progress: failing: the fingertip stays far from the target or moves away from it
poor: the fingertip gets only slightly closer to the target
fair: the fingertip approaches the target but is not yet close
good: the fingertip is close to the target
excellent: the fingertip is on the target and held there with little effort
Reacher-v5.healthy: Is the arm bringing its fingertip to the target or holding it there (not moving away, not flailing)?

progress.instructions: How well is the robot accomplishing its task in this segment?

summary_fields.segment_duration_s: length of the segment in seconds
summary_fields.forward_velocity_m_per_s: forward velocity along the x-axis (mean, min, max over the segment)
summary_fields.fingertip_to_target_distance_m: distance from the fingertip to the target
summary_fields.control_effort_0_to_1: mean squared motor command, from 0 (none) to 1 (maximum)
summary_fields.fell_over: whether the robot fell over during the segment
